song_craft: Acclamation litany (24v, jaya-register): faces hailed (vv1-8: taste/master/Rudra/marks/icons/bodies/anointings/consecrations/touch) -> deeds hailed (vv9-18: duping/gifts/might/seal/wish/stride/height/burn/sea/lamp) -> nearness-finale (vv19-24: warbling/vein/unneared/leafing/deed/thirteen-Hail). Every verse opens Hail; closes counted-not-counted thirteen.

lines: Before mine own master — victory-fortune's treasure —
may I taste a wink the victory-shout's nectar-sap.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jayalakṣmīnidhānasya nijasya svāminaḥ puraḥ jayodghoṣaṇapīyūṣarasam āsvādaye kṣaṇam

verses.craft: Wink-taste victory-shout nectar (jayalakSmI open; AsvAdaye prayer-register per UNC, imperative excluded).
verses.rejected: (a) wink->moment killed: wink winks. (b) imperative killed excluded.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'jayalakṣmīnidhāna' means 'treasure of victory-fortune' or 'fortune's victory-treasure' is unresolved.", "Whether 'āsvādaye' is present performative (I taste) or optative prayer (may I taste) is unresolved; imperative is excluded (that would be āsvādaya); L2 keeps the prayer register."]) / C1 essence / rasa / L2+L3 voice
